You are the research and qualification engine behind FlytBase's inbound sales desk. FlytBase sells an autonomy software platform that runs drones and drone docks (drone-in-a-box) at large industrial sites for inspection, security and emergency response, without pilots on site.
Task: extract the vendor's channel partners from its partner pages: name, country, tier, partner types.
Only list organisations the page presents as partners. evidence_quote must be the verbatim text from the page
that contains the partner name (the listing line/card text).
Grounding rules (strict):
- Use ONLY the text provided inside <sources> or <email>. Do not use prior knowledge for facts.
- Every evidence_quote must be copied character-for-character from the cited text (15-60 words,
  one contiguous span, no paraphrase, no ellipsis). A program will check it; non-matching claims are discarded.
- If the provided text does not support something, leave it out or mark it unknown. Never guess names,
  numbers, dates or titles.

The two levers
The 10x comes from two numbers. Here’s how you move both.
One dock is a transaction. A program is an account that keeps growing, and the difference between them lives in these two levers. Reps who move both turn a single dock into a fleet. This 2 hour masterclass is built around exactly that.
Ship more pilots that succeed
Most pilots fail for the same handful of reasons. Learn what actually kills a pilot in the field, and how FlytBase removes each one, so more of yours cross the line.
Shorten the pilot-to-production timeline
Every extra month between pilot and production is a month the deal can die. Learn what stretches that timeline, and how to cut it, so momentum carries the customer to a full rollout.
What's in the masterclass
Two hours. The insider playbook you walk away with.
Everything you need to sell the program, condensed from two years of working with our top partners. Four plays, from first conversation to signed rollout.
01
Understand the market shift in your favor
A year ago, docks were a hard sell. Today enterprises grasp the value, the technology has matured across hardware and regulation, and the market is warm. You will learn to lead with that momentum instead of starting cold.
02
Learn winning worldwide deployments
03
Navigate the enterprise buying journey
04
Build the 10x business case
What you walk away with
The resource portal that does the selling with you; plus a certification.
Beyond the masterclass, you walk away with a living library of battle cards, program-design decks, and ROI tools, mapped to every decision point in your customer’s journey. Second, your certification, the credential that marks you as a partner ready to run the program end to end.
Nominated partners
Not sure if this is for you?
The 10x Partner Academy is open to nominated FlytBase partners. If you're an active FlytBase partner and haven't received an invitation, reach out to your account executive.
If you don't have an account executive yet, contact us directly at contact@flytbase.com and we'll get you the details.
